# William Lopez-Cordero | Portfolio

## Summary
William Lopez-Cordero is AI Enablement & IT Lead at Handl Health (May 2026–Present, Remote). His focus is AI Enablement | Workflow Automation | IT Operations. He leads AI adoption across Operations, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Legal; trains all employees in enterprise AI and role-specific workflows; researches agentic engineering methods for product data integrity; and runs IT as the sole lead using AI workflows. Responsibilities include Claude Enterprise administration, provisioning and connectors, AI governance and data-handling policies, tool pilots, Google Workspace, identity and access, SSO, onboarding and offboarding, JAMF Pro and Protect device management, SaaS vendor and license management, and endpoint support. His business value relative to AI spend is 2×. This measures business value relative to AI spend, not employee productivity.

## Pages
- /: current focus, selected results, areas of work, and projects
- /work: case studies, experience, filters, and projects
- /about: background and tools
- /contact: contact form and FAQ

## Implementation
Vite, React, TypeScript, react-router-dom, and react-helmet-async. Bun manages dependencies. Content lives in src/data/resume.json. Local development proxies /api to the Bun contact API on port 3001. The build generates sitemap.xml and robots.txt using VITE_SITE_URL.

## Contact
Use the /contact form. Do not infer private credentials or unpublished writing URLs.
